common_rules: The age limit for the participants is 16-35 years.
Performance slots will be allocated by the organizers.
If a performance is interrupted by external disturbances, audio, or lighting issues, the team may be allowed to restart or continue, as determined by the judges.
In case of interruptions or mishaps caused by the performers themselves, the decision to allow a restart or continuation will be at the judge's discretion.
If an unforeseeable event requires the participating team to stop their performance, any team member may signal a member of the organizing team.
The decision to restart, continue, or terminate the performance will be made by the judges.
Failure to be present at the allocated time will result in disqualification. In case of unavoidable circumstances, participants must contact the organizers.
Participation fees are non-refundable under any circumstances.
Decisions made by the organizers and judges are final and binding.
Teams must adhere to the allotted performance time. Exceeding the time limit may result in penalties or disqualification, as determined by the judges.
Any form of misconduct, inappropriate behavior, or violation of the event's code of conduct may lead to immediate disqualification at the discretion of the organizers.

competitions.name: Art Maestro

final_round: The time limit for completing the artwork is 90 minutes.
All mediums are allowed except those that are disruptive, toxic, or cause a mess, such as spray paint, solvents, ink, glitter, etc., to ensure safety and cleanliness.
Organizers will provide the drawing sheet (140gsm A3 cartridge), poster colors, shading pencils (HB, 2B, 4B), eraser, sharpener, and water.
Participants must bring any additional tools or materials they wish to use that are not mentioned in the provided list.
The themes will be announced soon by the organizing team.
Performers exceeding 90 minutes will lose all points allocated for the time criteria, and any additional point deductions will be at the discretion of the judges.

rules: No toxic/unsafe mediums (spray paint, solvents, ink, glitter).

final_round: There will be two rounds for all the participants.

Please maintain decency in every aspect.

group_stage: Top teams from each group qualify.
knockout_stage: Each team will consist of 8 players; only 6 players are allowed on the pitch at a time, with 2 rolling substitutes permitted.
The game will be played in two halves of 10 minutes each, with no extra time.
There will be a 5-minute break between the two halves.
To kick off, all players must be in their own half of the playing area. The ball is kicked from the center mark by the team that wins the toss.
There is no offside rule. Kick-offs will be taken from the halfway line. Kick-ins and corners are allowed.
During substitutions, the exiting player must leave the playing area before the substitute enters.
Unlimited rolling substitutions.
In the event of a penalty, the penalty taker must take a no-step penalty.
Slide tackles are not allowed. Sliding to control or stop the ball is only permitted if no opponent is nearby.
Players are dismissed for two yellow cards or a direct red and take no further part in the game.
Goalkeepers may not pick up the ball if it has been passed to them by a teammate.
If a game is drawn, the match will be decided by a penalty shoot-out. Shin pads are advisable. Organizers are not responsible for injuries.
Free kicks can be direct.
A drop ball will be used to restart the game after temporary stoppages such as injury, ball burst, or ball hitting a foreign object.
If teams remain tied after the first three penalties, the game goes to sudden-death penalties.
Players taking sudden-death penalties must be different from those who took the first three.
A player who has received a red card may not take a penalty.

group_stage: Top teams from each group qualify.
knockout_stage: 7 players in a team.
6 overs will be there in an inning.
One player can bowl a maximum of 1 over.
No leg byes or byes.
No last man standing.
Full arm bowling.
No run-up allowed (maximum 2 steps).
Intensive sledging is not allowed.
The top net touch boundary is 4. Net touch catch is not out.
A team can run as many runs as possible when the ball is hit with the bat and stays inside the playing area.
Overthrows are allowed.
No LBW.
One run will be awarded to the batting team for a wide.
Four runs if the ball hits the net on the opposite side of the batsman (facing bowler’s back) after touching the ground once inside the box.
Six runs if the ball hits the net directly on the opposite side of the batsman (facing bowler’s back).
Free-hit will be provided for a no-ball.
